notes: DX5 II, firmware 2.58. The app showed five configs (Bass 1, Bass 2, Airy, Warm, Dynamic) with Bass 1 active. Done in order: the app connected and read its list ("connected"); the + button made a config (the app copied the active config Bass 1 and named it "devconfig6"; the app then showed a sixth config "devconfig6", selected) ("created"); that config was renamed to "eqcaps test 1" (the app showed that name) ("renamed"); it was deleted (the app showed five configs again, Bass 1 selected) ("deleted"). The app re-reads the list before it creates and after it deletes, not after a create or a rename. Not made with the userscript recorder: a logger run in the page wrote the raw report log, and it was converted afterwards, so the snapshots (one per step, holding no state) come from the logger's marks, and the device entry is copied from the 2026-11-20 recording. The meter frames, empty reports and the unit-identifying answers were left out when it was logged. The events from before the app disconnected and reconnected were dropped, so the file is one clean session; the heartbeats after the last step were cut.
